title: External transport of melanoma decision thresholds: lesion-level evaluation and reproducibility code
description: Version 2.1.0 accompanies the study of threshold transfer from HAM10000 to BCN20000. The version includes per-image scores and lesion identifiers, selected thresholds, lesion-level and image-level estimates, lesion-clustered and source-reselection bootstrap analyses, known identity-correction sensitivity analyses, and the embeddings-only XGBoost comparator. Original dermoscopic images are not redistributed. The current release is based on previously fitted image classifiers; score-level analysis does not reproduce initial CNN training. The prior v2.0.0 Zenodo DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.23130026.
